descriptionChirho: The gentilic adjective 'Tekoite' denoting a person from the town of Tekoa, south of Bethlehem. All 7 occurrences carry the same meaning. S145733 covers singular forms in both masculine and feminine (eng 'the Tekoite', spa 'la tecoita/el teqoita', arb 'التَّقُوعِيُّ/التَّقوعِيَّةُ', kor '드고아의/그 테코아 사람', swa 'Mtekoa', hin 'तकोइन की/के तकोई'). S145734 covers the masculine plural form (eng 'the Tekoites', spa 'los tecoitas', arb 'التَّقُوعِيُّونَ', kor '그 닄고아사람들이', swa 'Watekoa', hin 'तकोईयों ने'). The split is purely morphological — singular vs plural inflection of the same gentilic — not a distinct lexical sense.
